_about: Per-install config for LIFEOS/TOOLS/Achilles.ts. source_aliases ({old: current}) and source_ref_prefix_aliases ([["old:", "current:"]]) resolve registry rows stored under a source's old name after a rename; a fresh install has none. stack_terms are the platforms your estate runs on, added to the Atlas and GEAR terms by `achilles gen-stack`; replace the examples with yours.
